deadline.value: 11:59pm PST, December 14, 2026 (no late applications); Knight-Hennessy applicants: physics application by December 1, 2026
deadline.quote: The application deadline for this academic year 2026-27 (2027-28 admissions cycle) is 11:59pm Pacific Standard Time, Monday, December 14, 2026.

gre_subject.value: Physics GRE REQUIRED for all applicants
gre_subject.quote: For the Fall 2027-28 admissions cycle, The GRE General Test and the Physics GRE Subject Test are required for all applicants, as they help us fairly assess problem-solving skills.

supervisor.value: No pre-application supervisor requirement mentioned (you choose theory/experiment/astro area)

funding.value: Department provides financial support for all enrolled students
funding.quote: The Department provides financial support for all enrolled students.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) is the minimum requirement for Stanford graduate study.
entry_route.quote: You must hold, or expect to hold before enrollment at Stanford, a U.S. bachelor’s degree or its international equivalent from a college or university of recognized standing.

fee_waiver.value: Some applicants may qualify; see Stanford Graduate Admissions fee-waiver page for eligibility
fee_waiver.quote: Some applicants may qualify for an application fee waiver.

gre_general.value: GRE General REQUIRED for all applicants (exceptions case-by-case)
gre_general.quote: For the Fall 2027-28 admissions cycle, The GRE General Test and the Physics GRE Subject Test are required for all applicants

english_waiver.value: Not required if your degree (or international equivalent) is from a university where ALL instruction was in English; no documents needed at application
english_waiver.quote: You earned a U.S. bachelor’s, master’s or doctoral degree, or international equivalent from a university where all instruction was conducted in English.

notes: Two GRE requirements make Stanford one of the most test-heavy programs this cycle. Applicants pick theoretical, experimental or astrophysics; astrophysics is part of this PhD (Stanford has no separate astronomy PhD).
